work: Arthurs Seat Eagle is a ticketed scenic gondola between Dromana and Arthurs Seat summit, not an amusement park. Five official-editor duplicate searches for Arthurs Seat Eagle, Arthurs Seat and Dromana returned zero. The operator confirms current operation, two station addresses, weekly and Melbourne Cup hours, ten public one-way/return fares, accessible gondolas, eight-person capacity and quarter-hour ride. Two exact CC BY-SA 4.0 Wikimedia Commons photos of its branded blue gondolas were visually inspected and published with 2021 dates. Eight localized site pages and two photo binaries verified HTTP 200 before Facebook publication. The operator has discussed a future luge/mountain coaster; it is not open and has not been represented as an existing ride. The original backlog RCDB discovery mentioned a possible 2028 opening, but current sources do not confirm a date.
qualification: Separately ticketed sightseeing gondola, independent from any structured amusement park; the state park is a public nature area.
